Inviscid · the medium reacts · 2026-09-01

The Kick

One cell of a 5,488-body doubled block gets a fold impulse. Nothing else is driven. What spreads is not a general disturbance: linearised at the working fold, the medium's fold sector decouples exactly — the stiffness and mass cross-terms to translation and rotation are zero to 10⁻¹⁶ — so a fold impulse is a scalar wave on the lattice, and stays one. The 2026-08-30 measurement's “99.7% of the energy stays in fold + springs” is the finite-amplitude shadow of this exact fact.

Watch it

Every frame below is the model's own integration (velocity Verlet, gated against exact modal evolution; energy conserved to 3·10⁻⁵). Color is the signed fold deviation — copper opening, slate closing — normalised per frame so the wave stays visible as it decays; the readout gives the frame's true scale. The dashed circle is the prediction, radius = ½·t: the shell should ride it, arriving just behind. When the front reaches the wall of the box it does not reflect and does not wrap — it crosses into the twin sheet (right), which is what the double is. Drag to turn.

Views. The medium is space-filling — cells and voids tile the honeycomb — so the default cutaway draws every cell at its true scale and slices the block at the kicked cell's plane: the cut face is the wave's cross-section. Solid is the whole tiling from outside. X-ray shrinks quiet cells to points so the shell can be seen through the block — in that view the lattice's layers read as separated bands; the apparent empty planes between them are where the voids sit and the cells' own plates reach, which a centre-point rendering does not draw.

The energy sloshes; the total holds

Kinetic (copper) against joint-spring potential (slate), stacked; their sum holds to — over this run — the Verlet audit. Translation and rotation hold exactly zero energy: at linear order there is nothing else for a fold impulse to become.

Arrivals against the exact ½

First crossing of 20% of each cell's own peak, along the +x axis. The dashed line is the exact sound cone t = 2r. The near cells trigger ahead of the cone on the precursor; what converges to the band is the spacing between far arrivals — the far-field slope fits — against the exact 0.5, from below, as the dispersing front (Airy) steepens with distance.

What this sharpens. Statement 1 said the medium has one free motion; statement 2 gave it two sound speeds. This lane shows where a local fold disturbance lives between them: it is a scalar field riding one gapless band whose Γ point is the breathe and whose speed is exactly ½ — one member of the doubly degenerate ½ pair, its partner translational. “A fold impulse stays a fold” is not a percentage; at linear order it is the operator's block structure.

Scope. Harmonic, at a = −30°, linearised kinematics, k = 1 by convention (R8 measures the √k front scaling). The recorded finite-amplitude corrections — 0.3% translation, 0.1° rotation at fold rate 0.2 — are the nonlinear terms this lane does not model; they are the natural next measurement. Closure is the doubled block per Decision 22.
